Clarence Thomas has spent more than three decades reshaping American law—and refusing to bend to the political mob.

Drawing on exclusive interviews, my Supreme Court clerkship, and decades of friendship with Justice Thomas, my new book tells the story of one of America's most consequential and misunderstood justices.

Available Aug. 25. Pre-order: https://t.co/q2OTN7nebe

posts.text:
Clarence Thomas came from abject poverty, faced withering racism, and rose to the very pinnacle of the legal profession.

At a time when we are so divided and so angry at each other, we need role models. We need people we can look to and say: that is a life that made a difference.

That is why I wrote Going Further.

Order now at https://t.co/2ANWgLIPqD.
